'''''Zemai''''' is a staple grain of the [[Aiel Waste]], and is used in the production of [[oosquai]].

==Parallels==
Zemai is an anagram of maize, and is clearly the same crop as maize from the real world. The word was likely built out of the scientific name for maize: ''zea mays''.{{ref|[[Origins of the Wheel of Time]], ''zemai''}}
